clauses.clause: When this creature enters, you may search your library for a basic land card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
clauses.evidence: Trigger and may are in the trace: [cast] and [cast | ask 1 -> skip] ask may [fire, skip] and 'card's triggered ability [0] triggers'; the opponent's-turn entry triggers too. The probe library has no basic land, so nothing is fetched. Pack solemn_fetch_basic_tapped: the basic Swamp enters tapped, the nonbasic Caves stays (pass). Pack solemn_decline: skip leaves the Swamp in the library (pass). The shuffle is not observable
clauses.issue: Tree note, no behaviour difference: the SEARCH selector is ONE_OF where the compiler's B2b-etb-basic-land emits CHOOSE (the same as the Wavecaster and Fabled Passage packets); a count-1 search resolves the same either way.
